On that middle, 2026 so far has run 64% for January to February and 79% for June to July. Back in 2025, September to October came in at 214% on the middle. Grid 30122 had its driest year in 1976 at 44%.

46135.story: As of Oct 12, Yankton County has 75 years on record since 1951, and on the middle value of the county's 6 grids October to November came in under 90% of normal in 37 of them. In 2025 on the middle, January to February ran 33% of normal while June to July hit 158%. So far in 2026 on the middle, January to February sits at 6% and February to March at 14%. Grid 27730 had its driest year in 1980 at 53% of normal.
